stem:
Glycogen and cellulose are polymers.

Fig. 2.1 shows small, representative regions of a glycogen molecule and a cellulose molecule.

{{figure:figure_2_1.png}}

Fig. 2.1

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe **three** ways, **visible in Fig. 2.1**, in which the molecule of glycogen differs from the molecule of cellulose.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Explain how the structure of glycogen is related to its function in cells.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Explain how the arrangement of cellulose molecules in plant cell walls is related to their function.
